comments.body:
Plan-review RCA (orchestrator, after 7 BLOCK rounds) — the plan premise was WRONG about a load-bearing dependency.

The plan said: remove Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK from the enum plus its _ORDERED and MODE_CAPS entries, while preserving the _ref_lock pause sentinel gated_mode=="reconcile-check" byte-for-byte. Those two are CONTRADICTORY.

Evidence (src):
- _advisory_lock._mode_blocks() (src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/_advisory_lock.py:257) reads the pause-gate blob and computes blocking via `gated_mode = mode_mod.Mode.from_str(gated_mode_str)` then `target_mode > gated_mode`. gated_mode_str is the literal "reconcile-check".
- mode.py:_ORDERED (line 21) lists "reconcile-check" first; Mode ordering uses _ORDERED.index(value). from_str requires the enum member.
- So a paused repo (gate blob gated_mode=="reconcile-check", written at _ref_lock.py:717) is read BACK through Mode.from_str("reconcile-check"). Remove the enum/_ORDERED entry and from_str raises ValueError -> _mode_blocks logs "unrecognised mode; treating as no gate" -> returns False -> THE PAUSE STOPS BLOCKING. Live behavioral regression.

Decision (correctness-driven scope refinement): RETAIN Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK (enum member + _ORDERED entry + MODE_CAPS entry + from_str support) as a load-bearing INTERNAL gate/pause mode. It is NOT unused, so retaining it is consistent with the "remove deprecated/UNUSED surface" goal. REMOVE only:
- the legacy `rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check` CLI command surface (_cli parser/registry/help),
- the `--filter-local-ids` CLI surface,
- `_run_reconcile_check` direct-engine dispatch branch + its .bridge_state/reconcile-check.json writer (__main__.py),
- the orphaned `reconcile_check.py` discrepancy-report module (and its dedicated tests),
- the `reconcile_diagnostics` status/model/schema field (last_pass.py reader, _mcp_models.py, bridge_status.schema.json, types.py),
- repoint _bridge_runner MODE_COMMANDS["reconcile-check"] to `rebar bridge preview`.

Consequence: this SHRINKS test churn. All `Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK` references (test_mode.py, test_reconcile_once.py, test_recovery_write_boundary.py, test_advisory_lock.py, test_orchestrator_wiring.py, ...) STAY VALID because the enum is retained — plan-review finding 3 (migrate advisory_lock tests off the enum) is thereby moot. Only the reconcile_check-module tests (test_reconcile_check*.py) and the filter-CLI test (test_reconcile_filter.py) need deletion/migration.

Plan + file_impact rewritten accordingly.

comments.body: Blocked/residual semantic finding after Gerrit CL 2626 landed: the patchset-2 `_dc_support.py` migration from legacy `--filter-local-ids` to primary `--only` is not semantically equivalent for the live Jira DC inbound-create leg. `pass_support.resolve_selection()` resolves `--only` tokens only to existing local ticket ids or existing bindings (`bindings.get_local_id(token)`) and reports unresolved tokens otherwise; `load_phase` then calls `ensure_selection_current()` before narrowing inputs. For a not-yet-bound inbound Jira issue, neither the derived local id nor raw Jira key exists in local_tickets/bindings yet, so `sync --only <local_id>,<key>` can fail before the differ sees the inbound create. The removed post-filter path instead seeded `_build_filter_target_set()` with tokens verbatim and matched mutation `target`/`provenance.jira_key` after the full differ, so the raw Jira key could scope the inbound create. Per orchestrator instruction, this is a design escalation rather than a mechanical harness migration. Related citations: `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/pass_support.py` `resolve_selection`, `ensure_selection_current`, `narrow_selection_inputs`, `_build_filter_target_set`; `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/load_phase.py` selection resolution/narrowing; `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/apply_phase.py` post-filter behavior; `tests/external/live_jira_dc/_dc_fixtures.py` and `test_store_copy_isolation.py` comments documenting the inbound-create key+local-id requirement.

compiled_state.description:
## Goal

Fix forward after CL 2626: restore the direct-engine legacy-route `--filter-local-ids` post-filter that CL 2626 removed, while keeping the legitimate removals of top-level `rebar reconcile`, direct `--mode reconcile-check`, and stale `.bridge_state/reconcile-check.json` status diagnostics.

Why restore the flag: the active live Jira DC CI harness needs verbatim raw-key matching for inbound creates whose Jira key has no binding yet. Primary `--only` resolves before the differ and cannot express that case.

Preserve `_ref_lock.py` pause sentinel `gated_mode == "reconcile-check"` and keep `Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK` in `mode.py`/`_ORDERED`/`MODE_CAPS` because `_advisory_lock._mode_blocks` decodes the persisted sentinel through `Mode.from_str`.

## Scope

- Keep removed: top-level `rebar reconcile` registration/help/parser, direct `--mode reconcile-check`, `_run_reconcile_check`, `reconcile_check.py`, its JSON writer/reader, and `reconcile_diagnostics` schema/type/MCP fields.
- Restore: `--filter-local-ids` argparse support on the direct-engine legacy route in `request.py`, parsed into `ReconcileRequest.filter_local_ids`, and handed through `__main__.py` to `run_pass` for post-filtering.
- Reject `--filter-local-ids` on primary `preview`/`sync`; primary `--only`/`--except` remains pre-scoping selection, not a replacement for the post-filter.
- Revert the external live-DC harness helper to emit `python -m rebar_reconciler --mode <mode> --filter-local-ids <ids>` and keep comments/READMEs accurate about post-filter scoping.
- Clean live source comments that named deleted `reconcile_check.py`; leave immutable ADR historical references alone.

## Design decisions

1. Replacement remains distributed: `bridge preview` for live proposed changes, `bridge fsck --output json` for offline binding/orphan audits, and `bridge status --json` for operational state without stale reconcile-check diagnostics.
2. `Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK` stays as load-bearing persisted pause vocabulary, but direct `--mode reconcile-check` rejects before operational work.
3. `--filter-local-ids` is restored engine-only and legacy-route-only because it is a post-filter: it seeds targets with tokens verbatim and matches mutation target/provenance after the full differ. This preserves live-DC inbound-create scoping for raw Jira keys with no existing binding.
4. Follow-up `f8c4-ac9b-42c5-4bb0` owns any deeper selection/filter redesign.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_mode.py` proves the retained enum/order/caps support the pause sentinel.
- [x] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_reconcile_main.py` proves `--mode reconcile-check` rejects and `_run_reconcile_check` is not dispatched.
- [x] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge.py tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge_heldout.py tests/unit/workflow/test_bridge_provider_wrappers_heldout.py` proves the retained runner profile invokes `bridge preview`.
- [x] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_status_heldout.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_status_relocated_store.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_programmatic_heldout.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_model_schema_drift_heldout.py` proves BridgeStatus no longer exposes `reconcile_diagnostics`.
- [x] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/scripts/test_jira_pressure_test_preflight.py tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge.py tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge_heldout.py` proves the pressure probes preflight before mutation and the reconciler bridge profiles route through canonical bridge commands.
- [x] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_cli_heldout.py tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_advisory_lock.py tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_advisory_lock_ref_backend.py` proves pause docs still preserve `gated_mode == "reconcile-check"`.
- [x] NEW `tests/interfaces/facades/test_filter_local_ids_engine_restore_82bb_heldout.py` and NEW `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_reconcile_filter.py::TestFilterLocalIdsLegacyRoute` prove the engine-only `--filter-local-ids` legacy-route post-filter parses/hands off raw Jira keys and primary `preview`/`sync` reject the flag.
- [x] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/interfaces/facades/test_reconcile_cli_state_removal_82bb_heldout.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_filter_local_ids_engine_restore_82bb_heldout.py tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_reconcile_filter.py::TestFilterLocalIdsLegacyRoute` proves top-level `rebar reconcile` and `--mode reconcile-check` remain removed while the post-filter is restored.
- [x] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint` passes.
- [x] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck` passes.
- [x] `env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=4 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_3=safe.bareRepository GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_3=all PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make test` passes, deselecting only confirmed pre-existing host artifact `tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py::test_copy_repoints_sibling_origin_and_keeps_refs_isolated` if needed.

## Testing

Held-out oracles: `tests/interfaces/facades/test_reconcile_cli_state_removal_82bb_heldout.py`, NEW `tests/interfaces/facades/test_filter_local_ids_engine_restore_82bb_heldout.py`, NEW `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_reconcile_filter.py::TestFilterLocalIdsLegacyRoute`, `tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge_heldout.py`, `tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge.py`, and `tests/scripts/test_jira_pressure_test_preflight.py`. The new restoration oracle must be RED against the post-CL-2626 tree and GREEN after restoring the flag; mutation teeth must show removing the restored flag kills it.

## Out of scope

- `_lib_ops.py` / `_mcp_reads.py` Python/MCP `rebar.reconcile(mode=...)` removal was completed by c195.
- Do not change `_ref_lock.py` pause sentinel bytes/schema.
- Do not change canonical preview/sync/fsck/status semantics except removing stale status diagnostics.
- Do not force any ticket operation.
